analyst.summary: TAB-1 cannot be analyzed into in-scope test conditions because the issue has no describable requirement in the material provided. Project knowledge confirms AF automation uses locale coverage and test-data workbooks plus Guru/Resources for process and locale rules, but without ticket title, acceptance criteria, or linked specs, the Analyst must not infer flows or assertions. Human or orchestrator should supply full Jira issue details (or restate the requirement); until then the work item is blocked for test planning while environment and BASE_URL remain deferred ambiguities, not blockers by themselves.
